function.name: Music_3_PlayMedia
function.description: Plays the specified music track on a selected media player device. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

track.description: The title of the song to be played.

artist.description: The name of the artist performing the song. If not specified, any artist is acceptable.

device.description: The specific media player device where the music will be played.

album.description: The album where the song is from. If not specified, any album is acceptable.

function.name: Music_3_LookupMusic
function.description: Discover songs matching your taste. Provide information about the artist, album, genre, or year to receive a list of songs that fit the criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

artist.description: The name of the performer. Use 'dontcare' if you have no preference.

album.description: The title of the album. Use 'dontcare' if you have no preference.

genre.description: The music genre of the song. Use 'dontcare' to include all genres.

year.description: The release year of the song, formatted as 'YYYY'. Use 'dontcare' if you have no preference.

function.name: RideSharing_2_GetRide

ride_type.description: The type of cab ride preferred by the passenger.
